name: Calloway Pressline Auto-Lace Sneaker
description: A clean, minimal low-top sneaker with a slightly elevated sole and a streamlined lacing system that uses embedded micro-motors to tighten or release at a touch or BCI command. The upper is smooth woven synthetic in white, black, or stone. Positioned as everyday smart footwear — the kind of shoe that fits a work meeting and a post-work drink without looking wrong in either place.
functionality: BCI or touch-activated auto-lacing with three preset tension profiles. Battery lasts approximately 30 days on a charge.
what_it_says: You're comfortable with everyday tech and spend money sensibly. Not trying to impress anyone — this is just what you wear.
worn_by: retail and service workers with disposable income
story_hooks: A dead man's auto-lace sneaker is still paired to his BCI — and someone else's BCI just triggered it.
The micro-motor system can be hacked to lock the shoe tight enough to cause injury. A threat someone has already made good on.
